- On first app open: call `POST /api/tracking/install` with `appUserId` and `trackingToken` (or `code` fallback).
- On purchase: call `POST /api/tracking/convert` with `orderId`, `orderValue`, and `appUserId`.
- Set env vars: `TRACKING_SIGNING_SECRET`, `TRACKING_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS`, `ATTRIBUTION_WINDOW_DAYS`, optional `TRACKING_CONVERT_API_KEY`, `TRACKING_MAX_ORDER_VALUE`.
